recipes.ens: mean of a 365-day rolling ridge and LightGBM, with gas and carbon inputs, plus a level correction (half of the last 14 settled days' error)
recipes.ens-nofuel: mean of a 365-day rolling ridge and LightGBM, without fuel inputs, plus a level correction (half of the last 14 settled days' error)
recipes.lgb: LightGBM, plus a level correction (half of the last 14 settled days' error)
